title: Kicked Lebanese Kiwifruit Skewers
description: Spicy, crispy skewers that combine tart kiwifruit with a zesty Lebanese-inspired glaze for a single-diner hit.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190°C (375°F) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Slice the kiwifruit into 1/2-inch thick rounds, then cut each round into three equal wedges.
In a bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, smoked paprika, cayenne, cumin, mint, garlic, honey, and a pinch of salt.
Thread three kiwifruit wedges onto each skewer, leaving a small gap between wedges.
Brush the skewers generously with the spice mixture.
Arrange the skewers on the prepared baking sheet and bake for 12 to 15 minutes, flipping halfway, until the edges become crisp.
Remove from the oven, let rest two minutes, then drizzle with a light squeeze of fresh lemon juice.
Serve hot, optionally garnished with extra chopped mint or a sprinkle of smoked paprika.
